cover.title: Project Juniper
cover.sub: A specialist supplier of laboratory consumables to research and hospital laboratories.

exec.title: A recurring revenue business growing {cagr_t} a year with expanding margins

rows.p: {recur} of revenue repeats every year: laboratories reorder the same consumables on standing contracts.
Adjusted EBITDA margin rises from {m22} to {m26} as own manufacturing replaces bought-in product.
Low capital needs convert more than {cc} of EBITDA to cash in every year shown.
The top five suppliers hold only {top5} of a fragmented market, leaving clear bolt-on targets.

chart.title: Revenue has grown every year and the budget continues the trend

bullets: Volume growth of {vol} a year from new hospital contracts.
Price rises in line with inflation, accepted on every renewal.
Own-label range launched in FY24A now a fifth of sales.
takeaway.sowhat: Budget growth needs no new customers beyond the signed pipeline.

chart.source: Source: audited accounts FY22A to FY24A, management estimate FY25E and budget FY26B (fictional)
chart.note: A: actual. E: estimate. B: budget.

table.title: Margins have widened every year while capital needs stayed low

exhibit.title: Summary income statement and cash conversion

table.callout: Adjusted EBITDA nearly doubles from {eb22} to {eb26} over the five years, with capital expenditure held near four percent of revenue.
